fields.Name: IT37 - Subscription Channel Isolation
fields.Description: Pub/sub channel isolation over the wire: concurrent RemoteOperationProgress channels never cross-deliver (per-run discriminator proof), plus loud documented omissions for the statusUpdates session-hijack and unfiltered cacheInvalidation broadcast (SEC6/SEC7 in the register). 2 checks (SI1-SI2), client transport.
